{{Quote|Of course they were always looking to get rid of me. Only woman to head a security team on Serenno. Many said I couldn't hack it&hellip; Said I only got the job because my father was Count Adan's security chief before me. "''They''" say that the Count appointed me out of loyalty to my old man. An individual was the '''father''' of [[Candra Tymon]]. Her [[Parent/Legends|father]] served in a [[House Dooku security team|security team]] as a [[Chief of Security/Legends|Chief of Security]] for [[Count of Serenno/Legends|Count]] [[Adan Dooku|Adan]] of [[House Dooku]]. Adan Dooku appointed Candra Tymon as her father's successor, despite the fact that many on [[Serenno/Legends|Serenno]], including her father, doubted a woman could lead a security team.<ref name="AotE:HT4" />
